title: Viva La Vida
lyrics:
[00:12.74]I used to rule the world
[00:16.67]Seas would rise when I gave the word
[00:19.30]Now in the morning, I sleep alone
[00:23.57]Sweep the streets I used to own
[00:40.58]I used to roll the dice
[00:44.57]Feel the fear in my enemy's eyes
[00:47.78]Listen as the crowd would sing
[00:51.67]Now the old king is dead, long live the king
[00:54.50]One minute, I held the key
[00:58.46]Next, the walls were closed on me
[01:01.11]And I discovered that my castles stand
[01:05.38]Upon pillars of salt and pillars of sand
[01:09.28]I hear Jerusalem bells are ringing
[01:12.99]Roman cavalry choirs are singing
[01:16.48]Be my mirror, my sword and shield
[01:19.78]My missionaries in a foreign field
[01:23.38]For some reason I can't explain
[01:26.93]Once you'd gone, there was never
[01:29.45]Never an honest word
[01:33.25]And that was when I ruled the world
[01:49.76]It was a wicked and wild wind
[01:54.09]Blew down the doors to let me in
[01:56.80]Shattered windows and the sound of drums
[02:01.14]People couldn't believe what I'd become
[02:04.30]Revolutionaries wait
[02:08.08]For my head on a silver plate
[02:10.84]Just a puppet on a lonely string
[02:15.14]Oh, who would ever want to be king?
[02:18.84]I hear Jerusalem bells are ringing
[02:22.53]Roman cavalry choirs are singing
[02:26.04]Be my mirror, my sword and shield
[02:29.26]My missionaries in a foreign field
[02:32.98]For some reason I can't explain
[02:36.26]I know St. Peter won't call my name
[02:39.47]Never an honest word
[02:42.80]But that was when I ruled the world
[02:59.33]Oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh
[03:02.82]Oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh
[03:06.30]Oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh
[03:09.75]Oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh
[03:13.22]Oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh
[03:14.66]Hear Jerusalem bells are ringing (Oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh)
[03:18.22]Roman cavalry choirs are singing (Oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh)
[03:21.60]Be my mirror, my sword and shield (Oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh)
[03:25.03]My missionaries in a foreign field (Oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh)
[03:28.53]For some reason I can't explain (Oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh)
[03:31.93]I know St. Peter won't call my name
[03:35.14]Never an honest word
[03:38.44]But that was when I ruled the world
